title: Sw-SSFCM_Algs: reference implementation of spatial-weighted semi-supervised fuzzy c-means for hyperspectral image analysis
description: NumPy reference implementation accompanying the manuscript A novel approach to spatial-weighted semi-supervised fuzzy c-means clustering for hyperspectral image analysis (Computers & Geosciences). Implements Sw-SSFCM, a semi-supervised fuzzy c-means whose guidance term carries a frozen spatial prior obtained as the logarithmic opinion pool of Softmax posteriors over the pixel neighbourhood, together with the Sr-SSFCM control, the theta-rule for the guidance weight, the open-set prior for classes without labels, and the scripts reproducing the label-budget benchmark on six hyperspectral scenes.
